log.entry: Commission accepted: EmberBind — bookbindery in Marrow Bay
EmberBind: brief locked (audience, tone, naming) — consulted “Don't Make Me Think”, Steve Krug 2000
EmberBind: palette “Crimson Vista” locked (tetradic, WCAG-corrected)
EmberBind: wireframed across D1–D5 (5 relative layouts) — pattern “Studio”, F-reading
EmberBind: built — semantic HTML, 7 sections, 5 structural breakpoints
EmberBind: polished — motion, focus rings, spacing rhythm, copy pass
EmberBind: QA pass — CRAP audit clean, 4/4 breakpoints verified, 5 device classes checked
EmberBind: © stamped for Beast Studio — on the shelf at $640

crap: Contrast — PASS: every ink/background pair clears WCAG
Repetition — PASS: one spacing scale, one type scale, tokenised colours
Alignment — PASS: everything sits on the container grid
Proximity — PASS: related blocks grouped, section rhythm consistent
